purpose: Prevent false PASS states and define the remaining gates before AI Visibility V1 can be called complete.

gates.name: Core service answerability
gates.remaining: Maintenance only: review factual freshness when operational facts change; do not create duplicate intent pages without a genuine content gap.

gates.name: Official external profile alignment
gates.remaining: Directly observe public Facebook fields and compare them with canonical facts.

gates.name: Independent external entity evidence
gates.remaining: Accumulate genuine independent references that unambiguously identify this exact entity.

gates.name: Public search discovery
gates.remaining: Brand and non-brand discovery must be repeatedly observable, not inferred from crawlability.

gates.name: Fixed 50-prompt AI benchmark
gates.remaining: Run the frozen prompts on the actual target AI systems and record observable mentions, citations, descriptions and competitors.

gates.name: AI citation
gates.remaining: Require directly observed citation/source behavior on the target AI platform.

gates.name: Non-brand AI recommendation
gates.remaining: Require directly observed appearance for non-brand customer-demand prompts.

completion_rule: AI Visibility V1 is not complete merely because website/schema/SEO work is complete. G6-G8 require direct platform observations. Unknown or inaccessible platform results remain UNKNOWN/PENDING, never PASS by inference.
optimization_loop: Frozen prompts -> observe sources/competitors -> classify recommendation gap -> make evidence/content change -> allow rediscovery -> rerun the exact same prompts -> compare.
